item.title: Should Teams Mix People of Different Skill Levels?
item.description:
Background

When putting together a team, is it better to pair a highly skilled employee with someone less experienced, or to bring together people with similar abilities? And does appointing a leader necessarily improve the team’s performance?

To answer these questions, we need to consider more than what employees can accomplish today. Working in a particular team can also change their incentives to develop their skills and motivation for future work. This paper examines theoretically why the team structure that performs best in the short run need not be the best one in the long run.
